steps.details: HTs were synthesized by the coprecipitation method. Nitrates metallics such as Mg(NO3)2, Al(NO3)3, Co(NO3)2.6H2O, and Ni(NO3)2.6H2O were added gradually to sodium carbonate solution at 65 ◦C, without pH change. Once the nitrates were added, the solution was stirred for 1 h and crystallized for 4 h. The resultant solid was washed until neutral pH and then dried at 90 ◦C for 24 h.

steps.details: reconstruction methodology: A fixed amount of Ce(NO3)3.6H2O was complexed with EDTA solution at pH 10. The MMO from the HT was added to the solution and vigorously stirred for 24 h. The resulting solid was filtered, washed, and finally dried at 80 ◦C for 24 h.

evidence.section: 2.1. Hydrotalcite and mixed oxide synthesis
evidence.text_snippet: A fixed amount of Ce(NO3)3⋅6H2O (Merck, 99.99 %) was used and complexed with EDTA solution at pH 10 to get the chemical species of Ce [EDTA]-.
